lenses.asks: What does the Moon's rāśi, nakṣatra-pāda, dispositor and 10th-from-Moon say about the felt life and the public reputation?
lenses.style: clause clusters in square brackets, ruler-as-professor, 'check graha X + its drishti'

lenses.name: Soul-significator lens
lenses.asks: Which graha carries the most degrees (Ātmakāraka), which carries the least (Dārākāraka), and how are they placed?

agreement.convergent: every lens that took a side took the same side
agreement.divergent: lenses took opposite sides; both are shown, neither is averaged away
agreement.single-lens: only one lens spoke; treat as a lead, not a conclusion
agreement.descriptive: no lens took a side; this is portrait, not verdict

findings.beat: Ātmakāraka (soul-significator) is Budha, highest at 28.25° of Siṁha; its navāṁśa sign Dhanus marks the karakāṁśa, the flavor of what the soul is practicing.
findings.clause: [AK Budha at 28.25° Siṁha] [karakāṁśa Dhanus]

findings.beat: Shani, lord of bhava-1 (Tanu), sits in bhava-11 (Labha): the embodiment, temperament, vitality agenda is given a workable seat.
findings.clause: [Shani lords bhava-1] [seated in bhava-11: gains, networks, fulfilled goals]

findings.beat: Budha (in bhava-7) casts its drishti on the lagna: the first impression is colored by Budha's themes.
findings.clause: [Budha-drishti on lagna]

findings.beat: Shani (in bhava-11) casts its drishti on the lagna: the first impression is colored by Shani's themes.
findings.clause: [Shani-drishti on lagna]

chapters.title: Home ground
chapters.sub: Chandra · bandhu-bhava · where the feelings live

findings.beat: To source Chandra's feelings, check Shani, the dispositor of Makara: it sits in bhava-11 (Labha) in Dhanus, neutral, and aspects Surya, Shukra (and bhava 1, 5, 8).
findings.clause: [check Shani + Shani-drishti to source Chandra's feelings] [Shani in bhava-11, neutral] [aspects Surya, Shukra (and bhava 1, 5, 8)]
check: Shani and the grahas Shani aspects

findings.beat: Chandra shares Makara with Rahu (17.3° apart): the feelings carry hunger, restlessness and an appetite for the unconventional. Check Shani, the dispositor, for how that shows up.
findings.clause: [Chandra-yuti-Rahu] [hunger, restlessness and an appetite for the unconventional] [check Shani]

findings.beat: Shukra, lord of bhava-4 (Bandhu), sits in bhava-8 (Randhra): the home, mother, roots, property agenda is worked through transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden. A classroom with real homework; with awareness it is workable. Softened: Shukra's debility has cancellation conditions.
findings.clause: [Shukra lords bhava-4] [seated in dusthana bhava-8: transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden]
receipts: softener: Shukra's debility has cancellation conditions

findings.beat: Chandra in Makara: comforted by structure, rank and responsibility, settled into long-haul, disciplined rhythms, needs the work to be accountable.
findings.clause: [Chandra in classroom of Makara] [comforted by structure, rank and responsibility, settled into long-haul, disciplined rhythms, needs the work to be accountable]

findings.beat: Moon in Dhanishta-2 studies under Professor Kuja — curriculum of drive, courage and the first move. It reads as a rhythm-keeper: sensitive to tempo, ensemble, wealth-in-circulation and being 'in time' with others. The pāda falls in navāṁśa Kanyā, which colors how the star's themes are carried.
findings.clause: [Chandra in Dhanishta-2] [navāṁśa Chandra-Kanyā] [Professor Kuja]

findings.beat: Chandra sits in bhava-12 (retreat, expense, solitude, distant places): the felt life retreats inward; comfort is found in quiet, privacy or distance from the crowd.
findings.clause: [Chandra in vyaya-bhava] [comfort found in retreat and privacy]

findings.beat: Budha, lord of bhava-5 (Putra), sits in bhava-7 (Yuvati): the creativity, children, intelligence, romance agenda is given a workable seat.
findings.clause: [Budha lords bhava-5] [seated in bhava-7: partnership, contracts, the spouse]

findings.beat: Chandra lords the difficult bhava-6 (Ari) and sits in bhava-12: trouble-house lord in a trouble house, the classical setup for turning adversity into a resource (Harṣa pattern).
findings.clause: [Chandra lords dusthana bhava-6] [seated in dusthana bhava-12] [Harṣa pattern]
findings.caveat: Strength is reduced when the same graha also lords a good house.

findings.beat: Folk-reputation, counted as 10th-from-Chandra, falls in Tulā: negotiating, balancing, brokering. Its lord Shukra sits in Kanyā (debilitated), so that public face is built under strain, and learned the hard way. (Cancellation conditions exist for Shukra; see Partnership.)
findings.clause: [folk-reputation 10th-from-Chandra = Tulā] [negotiating, balancing, brokering] [lord Shukra: debilitated]

findings.beat: Bhava-6 (Ari) holds Guru, Ketu: attention is concentrated here, so service, daily routine, health habits, competition is a recurring subject of the life, not a side-note.
findings.clause: [Guru, Ketu in bhava-6: service, daily routine, health habits, competition]

findings.beat: Kuja, lord of bhava-3 (Sahaja), sits in bhava-4 (Bandhu): the initiative, skill, siblings, courage agenda is given a workable seat.
findings.clause: [Kuja lords bhava-3] [seated in bhava-4: home, mother, roots, property]

findings.beat: Kuja, lord of bhava-10 (Karma), sits in bhava-4 (Bandhu): the vocation, public role, authority agenda is given a workable seat.
findings.clause: [Kuja lords bhava-10] [seated in bhava-4: home, mother, roots, property]

findings.beat: Amātyakāraka (career-significator) is Chandra in Makara, bhava-12 (Vyaya): work is minister to the soul's purpose through retreat, expense, solitude, distant places.
findings.clause: [AmK Chandra in Makara] [bhava-12: retreat, expense, solitude, distant places]

findings.beat: Ketu in bhava-6 (Ari): release, refinement and quiet mastery gather where service, daily routine, health habits, competition is concerned.
findings.clause: [Ketu in bhava-6]

chapters.title: The crucible
chapters.sub: randhra-bhava · vyaya-bhava · what is hidden and transformed

findings.beat: Bhava-8 (Randhra) holds Surya, Shukra: attention is concentrated here, so transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden is a recurring subject of the life, not a side-note.
findings.clause: [Surya, Shukra in bhava-8: transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden]

findings.beat: Bhava-12 (Vyaya) holds Chandra, Rahu: attention is concentrated here, so retreat, expense, solitude, distant places is a recurring subject of the life, not a side-note.
findings.clause: [Chandra, Rahu in bhava-12: retreat, expense, solitude, distant places]

findings.beat: Surya (lord of bhava-7) and Shukra (lord of bhava-9) share Kanyā: a kendra-lord and a trikona-lord joined is the classical raja-yoga shape. It speaks through bhava-8 (Randhra), so its fruit arrives in that theme. Its seat is a dusthana, so the yoga is partial: fruit comes late and through effort.
findings.clause: [Surya + Shukra in Kanyā] [kendra-lord joins trikona-lord] [expressed via bhava-8: transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden]
findings.caveat: A yoga's fruit is limited by the dignity and house of the grahas that form it.
receipts: Sun (lord of bhava 7) + Venus (lord of bhava 9) in Virgo

findings.beat: Rahu in bhava-12 (Vyaya): appetite, experiment and over-reach gather where retreat, expense, solitude, distant places is concerned.
findings.clause: [Rahu in bhava-12]

findings.beat: Surya, lord of bhava-7 (Yuvati), sits in bhava-8 (Randhra): the partnership, contracts, the spouse agenda is worked through transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden. A classroom with real homework; with awareness it is workable.
findings.clause: [Surya lords bhava-7] [seated in dusthana bhava-8: transformation, shared resources, research, the hidden]

findings.beat: Shukra is debilitated in Kanyā (bhava-8): its significations are under strain and learned the hard way.
findings.clause: [Shukra debilitated in Kanyā] [bhava-8]

findings.beat: The strain on Shukra has a cancellation condition: Budha, lord of its debilitation sign Kanyā, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra; Guru, lord of Shukra's exaltation sign, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra. The weakness is real but not the final word.
findings.clause: [nīcha-bhaṅga for Shukra] [Budha, lord of its debilitation sign Kanyā, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra; Guru, lord of Shukra's exaltation sign, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra]
findings.caveat: Cancellation conditions vary by text; the ones that fire are named so they can be checked.
receipts: Budha, lord of its debilitation sign Kanyā, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra
Guru, lord of Shukra's exaltation sign, stands in a kendra from Lagna or Chandra

findings.beat: Dārākāraka (partner-significator) is Shukra, the lowest degree (5.59° Kanyā), in bhava-8 (Randhra). Debilitated by sign: the partner-lessons are learned through effort, not given.
findings.clause: [DK Shukra at 5.59° Kanyā] [bhava-8] [debilitated]

findings.beat: Shukra stands 8.16° from Surya, inside its combustion orb: its voice is overshadowed by the Sun's agenda.
findings.clause: [Shukra combust, 8.16° from Surya]

findings.beat: The running Mahādaśā lord Guru is exalted in Karkaṭa: this chapter of life has a strong author. It speaks for expansion, counsel and gains and, as lord of bhava-2 & bhava-11, through those houses.
findings.clause: [Mahādaśā Guru] [exalted in Karkaṭa] [lord of bhava-2 & bhava-11]

findings.beat: Guru sits in bhava-6 (Ari): the period's results arrive through service, daily routine, health habits, competition, which means effort, service or hidden work before reward.
findings.clause: [Mahādaśā Guru in dusthana bhava-6]

findings.beat: Inside it, the current Antardaśā belongs to Kuja (lord of bhava-3 & bhava-10), seated in bhava-4 (Bandhu): the sub-chapter's agenda — drive and decisive action — has an easy line of sight.
findings.clause: [Antardaśā Kuja in bhava-4]
